WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
), execution_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    oa.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_execution_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN order_averages AS oa
    ON oe.ordersmark = oa.ordersmark
  GROUP BY oa.timespan
), ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    oa.ordersmark,
    oa.timespan,
    oa.avg_fill,
    oa.avg_fill - eb.avg_execution_fill AS excess_fill,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY oa.timespan
      ORDER BY oa.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_averages AS oa
  JOIN execution_baselines AS eb
    ON oa.timespan = eb.timespan
  WHERE oa.avg_fill > eb.avg_execution_fill
)
SELECT
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  excess_fill,
  fill_rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE fill_rank <= 3;

assumptions.assumption: The time-in-force comparison figure is the average of non-null fillcount values across matched execution records for orders in that time span; orders with no executions are excluded.
